§6Nanomachines§f

§aInject robot swarms into yourself for potion effects and auto-protection.§f
Nanomachines are internal augmentations controlled by a neural network. You program triggers, and they grant status effects.

§6Controller§f:
Stores §e100,000 energy§f. Each active input node drains §e0.5 energy/tick§f. Reconfiguring the network costs §e5,000 energy§f.

§6Input Limits§f:
§e2 active inputs§f is safe. Going above that applies toxic debuffs. Hard maximum is §e4 active inputs§f.

§6Effects§f:
Speed, Haste, Strength, Jump Boost, Resistance, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Night Vision, and Absorption are available. So are Blindness, Nausea, Poison, Wither, and more if you're feeling chaotic.

§cWARNING:§f If the controller runs out of energy, it deals §e5 damage§f to you and restores §e50 energy§f to itself. Keep it charged or become a battery.
